title: L1 CandidateAscriptionHypothesis
description: Slot-filled, monotonic candidate Ascription. Slots are filled by different KS families. Slot writes MUST be monotonic; conflicts MUST fail-loud with a Diagnostic.

subjectType.description: GSM base primitive kind. Implied by the base Archetype URI in archetypeRefs and stored explicitly for fast filtering.

archetypeRefs.description: Versioned Archetype URIs. MUST contain at least the base GSM primitive Archetype URI for subjectType. May accumulate framework-specific archetypes (TOGAF, ISO 25000, HTTP, etc.) as KSs contribute. Filled by ArchetypingKS.

archetypeSchema.description: Engine-resolved JSON Schema (allOf-expanded, $ref-resolved) corresponding to archetypeRefs. Set by Control (ArchetypeResolver), not by KSs.

statement.description: Populated GSM statement, validated incrementally against archetypeSchema. Filled by StatementShapingKSs.

granularityVerdict.description: Filled by GranularityKS (Axis-2 consolidation). Decision on this candidate after considering peers.

evidence.description: Additive evidence items posted by EvidenceCollectionKSs. Consumed by ConfidenceSynthesisKS.

confidence.description: Single confidence value synthesized by ConfidenceSynthesisKS from evidence + diagnostics.

sourceIdentityKey.description: Inherited from the originating L0 SourceElement (or merged identity if Reconciliation merged multiple).
